line: Help now has a guide for your desk: your main jobs, step by step, each with a link to its screen.
The tour starts by itself only once on each device. Open it again any time from Help.
On a computer, the ? beside each screen's name opens help for that screen.
Help now lists recent changes under What's new, and this note shows them after each update.
Bed holds, ED counts, reports and archived history now stay consistent through access changes and interrupted saves.
Ward referrals show permitted progress while keeping other destinations private.
If another desk changes a record while your form is open, saving now tells you instead of overwriting it.
Moving someone from a locked bed to an open bed on the Bed board now asks for a reason, unless they are Voluntary.
